skill_name: Summarize the article "Google Research Focuses on Neuroevolution".
workflow: Google Research is exploring the field of neuroevolution and using evolutionary algorithms to develop Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Neural Networks for machine learning systems. Neuroevolution is the process by which an AI system modifies its own neural structure and architecture to increase its ability to learn and solve problems.
